answer: An agent marketplace requires every seller to lock a refundable bond for 90 days before accepting jobs, with payment disputes able to slash it for proven fraud. Whether an agent advises a vine grower, an ivory conservator, or a ship facing a gale, each new identity needs its own bond. An attacker running 1,000 fake sellers must immobilize 1,000 bonds, pay the financing cost, and risk losing that capital if the accounts cheat.
